## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour. Link a related issue if there is one.

## How was it checked?

List the relevant checks and results. For interface changes, include a screenshot
and note keyboard and narrow-terminal verification.

- [ ] Relevant checks pass (`uv run ruff check .` and `uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`).
- [ ] Documentation and the changelog reflect user-visible changes, where applicable.
- [ ] No personal data, downloaded artwork, generated catalogues, or credentials are included.
